title: CppCon 2018:H. Wright “Large-Scale Changes at Google: Lessons Learned From 5 Yrs of Mass Migrations”
summary: Hyrum Wright shares lessons from five years of mass code migrations in Google's huge C++ codebase. He covers why to migrate, how hard it really is, and how Google updates core libraries and their users continually.
why: HN points to it in monorepo and refactoring discussions as a great account of large-scale changes at Google.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The discussions from Hyrum Wright from Google about large-scale refactoring are great in this respect.
